name: crm_team
summary: Sales territories, coverage assignments, and period targets
description: Structured sales organization on top of the base CRM teams: hierarchical territories (geo, branch, industry, segment, product, named accounts), territory coverage links for sales teams, per-record territory assignments for leads and opportunities, and period sales targets by user or team across nine metrics. Targets are plans and are kept strictly separate from achieved results.
author: Nexa
